spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कलति)
To sound.
1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कालयति)
To throw or cast, to send;
also 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कलयति)
1 To go.
2 To count or reckon:
with आङ् prefixed,
1 To take.
2 To bind or tie;
with परि,
To keep in mind, to think or remember;
with वि,
To maim, to separate a part, to make defective;
with सम,
To sum up, to add.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Crude, undigested.
2 Weak.
m. (-लः)
1 A low or soft tone, as humming, buzzing, &c.
2 The Śāl tree.
3 In poetry, time equal to four mātras or instants.
n. (-लं)
1 Semen virile.
2 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba)
f. (-ला)
1 A small part of any thing.
2 A digit or one sixteenth of the moon's diameter.
3 A division of time, equal to thirty Kāṣas or about eight seconds.
4 The 60th part of one thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree.
5 Interest on a capital.
6 Any practical art, mechanical or fine, sixty-four such are enumerated, as carpentering, architecture, jewellery, farriery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c.
7 The menstrual discharge.
8 A boat.
9 Fraud, deceit.
E.
कल to sound, to count, &c. (-अच्) affix; or क pleasure, and ल what gives, from ला to bring, &c.

r. 1st cl. (कल्लते)
1 To sound ill or indistinctly.
2 To sound.
3 To be mute.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Deaf.
E.
कल्ल to sound indistinctly, affix अच.

r. 10th cl. (कालयति)
To count time.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Black, of a dark colour, dark blue especially, which is usually confounded with black.
m. (-लः)
1

Time.
2

A name of YAMA, regent of the dead.
3 A black colour.
4

Death.
5
A form of Ś

IVA.
6
The planet

Saturn.
7

The Koïl.
8 Cassia fistula.
9

Resin.
10

A plant, a red kind of plumbago.
n. (-लं)
1

Iron.
2

A black agallochum: see कालीयक.
3 A vegetable poison, perhaps the fruit of the Cocculus Indicus.
f. (-ला)
1 Indigo, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
2 A black sort of Tëori.
5 Calonji, (Nigella Indica.)
4 Madder, (Rubia manjith.)
(-ला or -ली)
A name of the goddess DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA.
(-ली)
1 The wife of ŚANTANU a king.
2 One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers.
3 A female deity of the

Bauddhas.
4

A row or succession of clouds.
5 Ink or blacking.
6 A worm or animalcule generated in the acetous fermentation of milk.
7 Abuse, censure, defamation.
8

Night.
9

Trumpet flower. (Bignonia suave-olens.)
10 One of the seven tongues or flames of fire.
E.
कल to count or reckon, &c. in the causal form, अच affix, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
1 A kind of fish: see शकुल.
2 Name of a species of prose composition.
E.
कल to count, &c. वुन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Black, dark coloured.
m. (-कः)
1 A freckle, a mark.
2 A water snake.
f. (-का)
The mother of a class of Asuras.
n. (-कं)
The liver.
E.
कल to reckon, (good or bad fortune,) वुञ् affix; or काल black, and कन् aff.

m. (-ण्ठः)
1 A low murmuring tone.
2 The Indian cuckoo.
3 A dove, a pigeon.
4 A goose.
E.
कल a low tone, and कण्ठ the throat; in whose throat it is made.

m. (-ण्ठः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A water fowl, a gallinule.
3 A sparrow.
4 A peacock.
5 A wagtail.
6 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa): see असन.
E.
काल black, and कण्ट the throat.

m. (-लः)
1 A confused noise, the murmuring or buzz of a crowd.
2 Resin, pitch, the resin of the Śāl tree.
E.
कल to sound, as above; the root reiterated.

f. (-का)
A wanton, a lascivious woman.
E.
कल, and कूज to coo, affix क्वुन्.

m. (-षः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
कल, घुष to sound, and घञ् aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A spot or mark.
2 Defamation, abuse.
3 The rust of iron.
E.
क BRAHMĀ, water, &c. लकि to deface, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Censorious, calumniating, defaming.
2 Spotting, staining.
E.
कलङ्क, and कर what makes.

f. (-ला)
A digit of the moon in shadow.
E.
कलङ्क, and कला a digit.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Spotted, stained.
2 Calumniated, defamed.
E.
कलङ्क and मयट् aff.

m. (-षः)
A lion.
f. (-षा)
A musical instrument: see करताली.
E.
कल a murmuring sound, and कष to make a sound, affix खच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spotted, soiled, stained.
2 Calumniated, defamed.
E.
कलङ्क, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्किनी-ङ्कि)
1 Soiled, stained.
2 Disgraced, reviled.
3 Rusty.
E.
कलङ्क, and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
An eddy, a whirlpool.
E.
कल a sound, and कुर to emit sound, क affix, and the termination of the 2nd case retained.

m. (-रः)
1 A crane.
2 A name of KAṂSA.

mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं)
An animal struck with a poisoned weapon.

n. (-टं)
The that of a house; other works read this कुटक q. v.

f. (-ता)
Melody, music.
E.
कल, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कलत्वं.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The hip and loins.
2 A wife.
3 A royal citadel, a strong hold or fastness.
E.
गड to distil, &c. अत्रच् affix, क is substituted for ग, and ड and ल are interchangeable: see कडत्र; or कल weak, feeble, and त्र, from त्रै to preserve, affix ड.

Gold.
2
Silver: see the next.

Gold.
2

Silver.
3
A low or pleasing tone; also कलधूत.

f. (-पिः)
1 A streak of gold.
2 Illumination of a manuscript with gold.
E.
कलधौत, and लिपि writing.

m. (-निः)
1 The turtle dove.
2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
3 A peacock.
4 A low sweet tone.
E.
कल, and ध्वनि a sound.

n. (-नं)
1 A spot, a stain.
2 An offence, fault, defect.
3 Murmuring, sounding.
4 An embryo or the first vestige of the foetus.
m. (-नः)
A sort of cane.
f. (-ना)
1 Subjection, submission.
2 Chattering, talking.
3 Shedding, emitting.
E.
कल to count, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
A man of a mixed caste.

f. (-का)
Knowledge, intelligence, wisdom in general.

m. (-भः)
1 A young elephant: see कल.
2 The Datura plant.
E.
कल to cast, अभच् Uṇādi affix; or according to some authorities कृ to cast, अभच् affix, making करभ, and र is then changed to ल.

m. (-मः)
1 Rice which is sown in May and June, and ripens in December or January; a white rice growing in deep water: see शालि.
2 A pen, a reed for writing with.
3 A thief, a rogue.
E.
कल to count, &c. and अमः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-म्बः)
1 An arrow.
2 The stalk of a potherb.
3 The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba): see कदम्ब.
n. (-म्बं)
Calumba root, (Menispermum calumba.)
f. (-म्बी) or m. and f. (-म्बः-म्बी)
A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus repens, &c.) see कडम्बी.
E.
कड to delight, अम्बच् affix, ल substituted for ड, fem. affix ङीष्; also कलम्बक.

f. (-का)
1 A potherb: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to कलम्बी.
2 The nape of the neck.
E.
क the head, and लबि to be, to rest, ण्वुल aff.

f. (-का)
Lending, a loan.
E.
कल a part, and अम्ब to go, वुन् aff.

m. (-टः)
Fresh butter.

f. (-म्बूः)
A potherb: see कलम्बी the fem. affix being ऊञ्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Computing, calculating.
E.
कल to count, शतृ aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A dove, a pigeon.
2 The Indian cuckoo.
3 A low or pleasing tone, a humming, buzzing, &c.
E.
कल a low tone, and रव what utters.

mn. (-लः-लं)
The womb, the uterus; according to some, the embryo one month after conception.
E.
कल to reckon, अलच् aff.

m. (-जः)
Resin, the extract of the Śāl tree.

m. (-वः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
कललज, and उद्भव birth.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A sparrow.
2 A plant, (Echites antidysenterica): see कलिङ्कक.
3 A spot, a stain.
4 A white Chowri.
E.
कल a low tone, chirping, &c. वकि to go, &c. अच् affix, the deriv. is irr; also कलविङ्कक.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
An earthen water pot; also कलस, कलशि, &c.
E.
क water, लश to labour, क aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
A water jar: see कलश.
m. (-सः)
1 A measure, a Droṇa: see द्रोण.
2 A rounded pinnacle or ball on the top of a temple.
f. (-सी)
A plant: see कलशि, &c.

f. (-शिः)
1 A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.)
2 A water jar.
E.
क water, लश to labour, &c. कि affix; also कलशी and कलसि.

f. (-शी)
1 A plant.
2 A water jar: see the preceding, and कलश.

f. (-सिः)
See कलशि.

m. (-तः)
A name of the saint AGASTYA: see घटोद्भव and अगस्त्य.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
कलस, and उदधि the same.

n. (-रं)
A low musical sound.
E.
कल, and स्वर a note.

mn. (-हः-हं)
1 War, battle.
2 Strife, contention.
m. (-हः)
1 The sheath of a sword, a scabbard.
2 A road, a way.
3 Deceit, falsehood.
4 Violence without murderous weapons, abuse, beating, kicking, &c.
E.
कल a pleasing sound, and ह what destroys, from हन with ड aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A drake, or according to some, a teal.
2 A gander.
3 Another bird, (Gallinula porphyria.)
4 BRAHM or the Supreme

Being.
5

An emperor.
6 A species of the Atijagatī metre.
E.
कल pleasing sound, and हंस a goose.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Contending with, fighting.
2 Quarrelsome, turbulent.
E.
कलह, and कार who makes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Assailing, contending or fighting with.
2 Quarrelsome, fractions, turbulent.
E.
कलह, and कारिन् who makes.

m. (-नः)
Febrifuge nut plant.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Quarrelsome.
m. (-यः)
NĀRADA.
f. (-या)
The Maina, a bird.
E.
कलह, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-ता)
An appeased wife, one who has been angry and is sorry for it.
E.
कलह strife, अन्तरित covered, &c. fem. affix टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken by force.
E.
कलह, and अपहृत taken away.

n. (-लं)
Poison.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Skilled in the elegant arts; singing, dancing, &c.
E.
कला, and कुशल clever.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
Gay, frolicsome, wanton.
m. (-लिः)
A name of KĀMA or love.
E.
कला deceit, and केलि who sports.

f. (-का)
The fore arm, the arm below the elbow; also कलाची.

f. (-ची)
See the preceding.

m. (-दः)
A goldsmith: see कणाद.
E.
कला an art, and दा to give, ड aff.

m. (-धिः)
The moon.
E.
कला a digit, निधि a treasure; containing many digits.

m. (-दी)
1 A bee, but particularly one of a very large kind.
2 A sparrow.
3 The Cātaka, a bird so called.
E.
कल a buzz, &c. अनुनद to sound, णिनि aff.

m. (-दी)
1 A large black bee.
2 A sparrow.
3 The francoline partridge.
E.
काल season, and अनुनादिन् who sings or sounds.

n. (-रं)
Interest, profit.
E.
कला a part, अन्तर over.

n. (-रं)
1 Interval, intermediate time.
2 Period, process of time.
2 A former or another time.
E.
काल, and अन्तर between, &c.

m. (-पः)
1 An ornament in general.
2 A zone, a string of bells worn by women round the wrist.
3 A peacock's tail.
4 Assemblage, multitude.
5 A quiver.
6 The moon.
7 A clever and intelligent man.
8 The name of a grammar of the Sanscrit language, ascribed to the god

KĀRTTIKEYA.
9

A village where the destroyer KALKI is to be born.
10 A poem written in one metre.
E.
कला an art, a division of time, &c. आप to obtain, and अण् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 A serpent's hood.
2 A demon, an imp or goblin.
3 A student of the Kalāpa grammar.
E.
कलाप, and अण aff.

m. (-कः)
A rope on an elephant's neck.
n. (-कं)
1 A number of verses in one metre.
2 A series of four stanzas on one subject.
3 A loan to be repaid when the peacocks spread their tails.
E.
कलाप and वुन् aff.

m. (-पी)
1 A peacock.
2 The Indian cuckoo.
3 Waved leaf fig tree.
4 The author of the Kalāpa grammar.
f. (-नी)
1 The moon.
2 A species of cyperus.
E.
कलाप a peacock's tail, &c. इनि aff.

m. (-र्णः)
The moon.
E.
कला a digit, and पूर्ण filled, complete.

m. (-भृत्)
1 The moon.
2 An artist, a mechanic, &c.
E.
कला a digit, &c. and भृत् who cherishes.

m. (-कः)
A kind of rice ripening in the cold season: see कलम.

f. (-म्बिः)
Lending, a loan: see the next.

m. (-यः)
The name of various leguminous seeds, chiefly of the order Phaseolus, particular kinds of pulse or vetches.
E.
क wind, ला to bring or give, and युक् aff.

m. (-ञ्जः)
One who trembles and totters as he walks.
E.
कलाय, and खञ्ज a wagtail.

m. (-नः)
A tumbler, a dancer, but especially one who dances or walks on a sharp edge, as the edge of a sword, &c.
E.
कला a part, and अयन going.

m. (-पः)
A bee, &c.
E.
कल buzz, and आलाप speech.

m. (-वान्)
A name of Candra or the moon.
f. (-ती)
1 A celestial lute or

Vīṇā.
2
The mother of

RĀDHĀ.
3
An

Apsaras.
4

A mystical ceremony, initiation of the Tāntrika student, in which the goddess DURGĀ is supposed to be transferred from the water jar to the body of the novice.
E.
कला a digit, or कल a sweet tone, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
A cock.

m. (-लः)
A sparrow: see कलविङ्क.

m. (-कः)
A musical instrument; also काहल.

m. (-लिः)
1 The fourth age of the world, according to the Hindus; the iron age, or that of vice: the commencement of the Kali-yug or age, is placed 3,101 years anterior to the Christian aera, so that in A.

, the Kali year is 4,931, the number of its years is 432,000, at the expiration of which, the world is to be destroyed.
2 The age personified.
3 War, battle.
4 Strife, dissension.
5 An arrow.
6 Beleric myrobalan.
f. (-लिः or ली)
An unblown flower: see कलिका.
E.
कल to count or reckon, इन् Uṇādi aff.

ind.
To-morrow.

m. (-कः)
A curlew.

f. (-का)
1 An unblown flower.
2 The bottom or peg of a lute.
E.
कल to count, इन् affix कलि, and with ङीष्, कली as above; again, कन् pleonastic affix, and टाप् fem. do.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to time.
2

Seasonable.
3

Of long standing.
4 Of a dark colour, black, blackish, &c.
m. (-कः)
The curlew.
n. (-कं)
A black kind of Sandal: see कालीयक.
f. (-का)
1 Cloudiness, a multitude or succession of clouds.
2 A dark cloud threatening rain.
3 A fog or mist, &c.
4 The goddess GAURĪ.
5 A terrific goddess, a form of CAṆḌĪ or

DURGĀ.
6
A female singer of

Svarga.
7

Blackness, a black colour.
8 A fault or flaw in gold, &c.
9 Spirituous liquor.
10 A plant: see वृश्चिकपत्र.
11 A kind of potherb.
12 The branch of a cucumber plant.
13

Spikenard.
14

A line of hair extending to the navel.
15 A female crow.
16 Price of a commodity on credit, or a price to be paid at a fixed period, or by instalments.
17 Periodical interest paid by the month, &c.
18 An animalcule formed by the fermentation of milk.
19 Ink or blacking.
20 A small bird, commonly Śyāma.
21 A medicinal plant: see काकोलि.
E.
काल black, &c. ठक् or कन् affix.

m. (-कः)
A curlew, a sort of heron: see कालिक.

n. (-र्व्वं)
Acts leading to future consequences, not connected with those of a previous birth.
E.
कलिका a bud, अपूर्व्व not preceding.

m. (-रः)
1 A plant bearing a nut, which is used as a febrifuge, (Grey bonduc): see पूर्तिकरञ्ज.
2 The fork-tailed shrike.
3 Another bird, a small one with a yellow head, (Loxia philippensis.)
4 A name of NĀRADA.
f. (-री)
A poisonous plant: see लाङ्गली.
E.
कलि strife, &c. कृञ् to make, affix अण्; also with कन् added कलिकारक.

m. (-कः)
1 Grey bonduc; also कलिमारक.
2 The name of NĀRADA a divine sage, and great mischief maker: see कलिकार.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The febrifuge nut plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella.)
2 The fork-tailed shrike, (Lanius forficatus, Lath.)
2 The name of a country; the name Kaliṅga is applied in the Purāṇas to several places, but it especially signifies a district on the Coromandel coast, extending from below Cuttack to the vicinity of Madras, in this sense, like some other names of countries, it is usually confined to the plural number, (-ङ्गाः) confounding the place with the people inhabiting it.
nf. (-ङ्गं-ङ्गा)
A medicinal seed, that of Echites antidysenterica.
f. (-ङ्गा)
1 A woman of a good shape.
2 A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum): see त्रिवृत्.
E.
कलि strife, &c. ग from गम to go, खच् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Produced in or belonging to the Kaliṅga country.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 An elephant.
2 A snake.
3 A species of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.)
4 A sort of iron.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A gourd or cucumber.
n. (-ङ्गं)
The water melon.
E.
कलिङ्ग a country, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
The seed of the Coraiya, (Echites antidysenterica): see इन्द्रयव.

m. (-ञ्जः)
A mat, a screen of grass, a tāti, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gained, acquired.
2 Known, understood.
3 Numbered, reckoned.
4 Separated, divided.
4 Made, done.
6 Held, laid hold of.
7 Sounded indistinctly, buzzed, murmured, &c.
E.
कल to count, &c. affix क्त.

m. (-मः)
Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica,) also कलि, the tree of strife; being supposed to be the favorite haunt of imps or goblins.

m. (-न्दः)
1 The sun.
2 A mountain.
3 Beleric myrobalan.
E.
कलि strife, दा to give, खश् aff.

f. (-न्या)
The Yamunā.
E.
कलिन्द the sun or a mountain, कन्या daughter.

f. (-नी)
The Yamunā or Jumna river.
E.
कलिन्द the name of a mountain, part of the Himālaya range, and नन्दिनी a daughter; the source of the river being in the mountain Kalinda.

f. (-ता)
The Yamunā river: see the preceding.
E.
कलिन्दशैल the mountain, and जाता born; also कलिन्दसू, कालिन्दी, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Quarrelsome, mischievous, mischief making.
m. (-यः)
1 A monkey, an ape.
2 NĀRADA.
E.
कलि strife, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Bonduccella): see पूतिकरञ्ज.
E.
कलि strife, मृ to destroy or remove, affixes अण् and कन्; some copies read कलिकारक.

n. (-गं)
The Kali, the present or iron age: see कलि.
E.
कलि, and युग an age.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Impervious, impenetrable.
2 Mixed, blended.
E.
कल to count, &c. इलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-क्षः)
Beleric myrobalan.

m. (-क्कः)
A musical instrument; a cymbal.
f. (-क्का)
1 A tavern.
2 A meteor.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)

काल, and अशौच impurity.

f. (-ता)
Time, date, season.
E.
कालिक, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कालिकत्वं.

m. (-सः)
The name of a celebrated poet, author of Śakuntalā, Vikramorvaśī, the Megha Dūta, the Raghu Vaṃśa, the Nalodaya and other poems: he was one of nine poets or gems of VIKRAMĀDITYA'S court, and is supposed to have flourished in the century preceding the Christian aera; the name is however applied to more persons than one, and seems, in some measure, to have been used as an honorary title; the works attributed to this author are amongst the most elegant compositions in the Sanskrit language.
E.
काली the goddess DURGĀ, and दास a slave, the final of काली being made short.

m. (-कः)
The poet KĀLIDĀSA: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to कालिदास.

f. (-नी)
One of the lunar mansions: see आर्द्रा.
E.
काल time, affixes इनि and ङीष्.

n. (-कं)
The water melon.

f. (-न्दी)
The YAMUNĀ or JUMNA river.
E.
कलिन्द a mountain, part of the Himāla range, and the seat of the river's source, अण् aff.

m. (-णः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
कालिन्दी the YAMUNĀ, and कर्षण the plougher; having diverted the stream into a new and devious channel, marked out by his ploughshare.

m. (-नः)
BALARĀMA.
E.
कालिन्दी, and भिद् to break, affix ल्युट्: see the preceding word.

f. (-सूः)
The wife of SŪRYA and mother of YAMUNĀ the personified river.
E.
कालिन्दी, and सू who bears, from सू to bear children, and क्विप् aff.

m. (-रः)
YAMA.
E.
कालिन्दी, and सोदर brother.

m. (-मा)
Blackness.
E.
काल black, इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to time, &c.
m. (-यः)
A serpent destroyed by KṚṢṆA.
E.
काल, and घ aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to time, to blackness, &c.
n. (-यं)
A dark kind of Sandal, or perhaps of Agallochum: see कालीयक.
E.
काल black, and छः aff.

f. (-ची)
The court of judgment of YAMA, regent and judge of the dead.

m. (-यः)
A buffalo.
E.
काली the goddess, and तनय a son: i. e. a favourite.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Timely, seasonable, relating to time.
E.
काल, and ख aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A yellow fragrant wood, perhaps a species of aloe wood.
2 A dark kind of Sandal wood.
m. (-कः)
A species of turmeric, (Curcuma zanthorhiza): see दारुहरिद्रा.
E.
कन् added to the last, of a black or blackish hue; also कालीय, कालेय, &c.

n. (-ष्यं)
Foulness, dirtiness, turbidness, opacity.
E.
कालष, and यञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Belonging to the Kali age, &c.
2 Dark coloured.
n. (-यं)
1 A yellow fragrant wood: see कालीयक and कालीयक.
2 The liver.
m. (-यः)
The name of a demon or imp.
E.
काल or कलि, and ढक् affix.

m. (-कः)
A sort of curcuma, (C. zanthorhiza, Rox.) see कालीयक.
n. (-कं)
A yellow fragrant wood.
E.
कन् added to the preceding word.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Produced in due season.
E.
काल, उत्पादित engendered.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Sown in due season.
E.
काल, and उप्त sown.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Artificial, fabricated.
2 Fictitious, invented.
E.
कल्पना, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
Zedoary: see कल्पक.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sprung from a virtuous or fortunate woman.
E.
कल्याणी, and ढक् affix, इनञ् inserted.
